chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - UI
chunks.content: ## CLO 2025.0 User Interface Updates This section covers the key user interface (UI) changes introduced in CLO version 2025.0, including the new library system, collector function improvements, window mode behavior, and display settings persistence within project files. --- ### New Library System and Collector Function CLO 2025.0 introduces a new default library window designed to improve workflow efficiency. Users can switch between the new library and the old library at any time by clicking the return key. **Collector Function Enhancement:** - A new "collector before the transfer" function has been added, speeding up the process of transferring collectors and enabling users to quickly build their preferred workstations. - In the new library, accessible via the add button, users can choose either to create a new library or use the collector before transfer option. - Right-clicking on a collector or file now reveals an additional option, **Display in Resource Manager**, which quickly locates the file path. This applies to both old and new libraries and eliminates the need to re-add collectors manually. --- ### Window Mode and Editor Improvements Previously, switching window modes reset the window selection tab, and the UV editor and 2D window could not be displayed simultaneously, requiring users to switch back to simulation mode to view the 2D window. **Updates in 2025.0:** - The UV and animation editors no longer reset when changing window modes, allowing simultaneous use of different editors and tools without mode switching. - The UV editor is now prominently located at the top of the menu, enabling quick access and seamless switching between editing windows. - This change streamlines the editing workflow by reducing unnecessary mode switches, thereby speeding up the design process. --- ### Display Settings Persistence in Project Files Starting in version 2025.0, display settings for the 3D and 2D vertical menu bars can be saved directly within the project file, ensuring consistent UI layout when reopening projects. **Key Details:** - When opening a newly created or saved project, its display settings (3D and 2D vertical menu bar configurations) are automatically applied. - When opening a project while another is active, users can choose to either apply the saved display settings or maintain the software’s default UI settings. - This feature currently applies only to project files saved in version 2025.0 or later; files from earlier versions do not contain display settings. - Future updates will extend this support to clothing files for better consistency across file types. - This feature aims to reduce errors by creators and receivers when verifying 3D file results. --- ### Thumbnail Preview Customization for Project Files With version 2025.0, the project file icon is displayed using a thumbnail preview. Users should avoid using PNG thumbnails from other files to prevent inconsistencies. **Thumbnail Settings:** - Thumbnail preview options are configurable via **User Customization** under **Settings > Default Files** in the main menu bar. - The default option for saving thumbnail previews is unchecked.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - UI
chunks.content: - This feature aims to reduce errors by creators and receivers when verifying 3D file results. --- ### Thumbnail Preview Customization for Project Files With version 2025.0, the project file icon is displayed using a thumbnail preview. Users should avoid using PNG thumbnails from other files to prevent inconsistencies. **Thumbnail Settings:** - Thumbnail preview options are configurable via **User Customization** under **Settings > Default Files** in the main menu bar. - The default option for saving thumbnail previews is unchecked. Users can enable it and select the thumbnail type: - **Current View:** Saves the thumbnail based on the current 3D view, matching previous version behavior. - **Four Views:** Saves a multi-view thumbnail including front, back, left, and right angles. - **Custom View:** Allows users to open and save multi-view settings files according to custom selections. - **All Clothing:** Saves the thumbnail as the main body of clothing. **Important Notes:** - Views automatically adjust to fit the clothing only and exclude models. - It is recommended to hide the model when saving multi-view or custom thumbnails to ensure clarity. - These settings provide flexibility in how thumbnails are saved, improving workflow efficiency and file organization. --- ## Summary CLO 2025.0 delivers significant UI improvements including a new library system with enhanced collector functions, more flexible window and editor behavior, project-based display settings persistence, and customizable thumbnail previews for project files. These updates collectively streamline workflows, reduce errors, and enhance the user experience for garment design and editing.
